scenarios.description: Keyed by scenario prefix. Data columns exist for `ac`, `pp`, `fc` and `pl`. Of the variance prefixes (`dac`, `drac`, ...) only `sortIndex` is read.

fallback.description: Style returned for scenario names not present in `scenarios`.

RuleSetConfig.description: Serializable rule-set configuration written by `<bn-ruleset>` and consumed by `IBCSRuleSet`.

name.description: Display name. Slot 1 shows it as is, the slots 2 to 4 with their number ("Budget", "Budget2"). A name that a `<bn-ruleset>` sets replaces the i18n labels `global.<prefix>1` to `global.<prefix>4`. The built-in names do not.

colorIndex.description: Selects the theme style slot the scenario is drawn in: 10 = `ac` (solid), 20 = `pp` (light), 30 = `fc` (hatched), 50 = `pl` (outlined). Any other value counts as 10.

sortIndex.description: Base sort index for column ordering; variant n adds n*10.

ScenarioRuleConfig.description: Per-scenario-prefix rule overrides. Variants 1-4 are derived from the base values.
